reasoning: 驗證目標：Tuner 來源下由 HU ICS HMI 觸發 Tune Down，頻率遞減到波段內下一個較低頻率並播放該電台。關鍵情境條件：Cabin Output Channel 已選 HU Tuner source、FM analog tuner mode；一條在波段中段、一條在波段下緣。為什麼這樣切：與 025 對稱，依 §8.3 以邊界為軸拆兩條；wrap-around 文字在 CFTS 4872450，037 未配置給任何 leaf，依 Profile §4 併入本 leaf（A-AM10）。刻意略過：VR Command 觸發路徑依 R8 不納入，改由 CFTS028 交付承擔。

distinguishing_axis.delta: 027-01 由波段中段遞減至下一個較低頻率；027-02 位於波段下緣，遞減後 wrap-around 回到波段最高頻率

assumptions: [A-AM10] CFTS024-4872449 (decrement to the next lower frequency and play) and CFTS024-4872450 (wrap-around at the band lower end) are unallocated Subsystem Functional Requirements in §1.3.5 that elaborate this leaf; verified here per Profile §4.
[R8] VR Command trigger path is out of scope, delegated to CFTS028.

tcs.tc_title: Tune Down decrements to next lower station in band
tcs.test_item:
When the Cabin Output Channel has selected the HU Tuner source, the user can request a Tune Down to decrement the station using the HU ICS HMI. The HU will tune to the new Station and Play that Station.

(Tune Down from mid-band)
tcs.pre_conditions:
1. An FM/AM signal generator is ready
2. The HU Tuner source is selected on the Cabin Output Channel
3. The HU is in FM analog tuner mode
4. The tuned frequency is not at the lower end of the current wave band
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Read and record the tuned frequency shown on the Radio Playing page
2. Press "Tune Down" on the Radio Playing page
3. Read the tuned frequency and listen to the audio output after the tune completes
tcs.expected_result:
1. The tuned frequency is displayed on the Radio Playing page
2. The tune request is accepted
3. The tuned frequency is the next lower frequency in the current wave band relative to the frequency recorded in step 1, and that station is played
tcs.design_method: 功能測試 (Functional based ; no specific technique)

tcs.tc_title: Tune Down at band lower end wraps to highest frequency
tcs.test_item:
When the Cabin Output Channel has selected the HU Tuner source, the user can request a Tune Down to decrement the station using the HU ICS HMI. The HU will tune to the new Station and Play that Station.

(Tune Down at the lower end of the wave band — wrap-around)
tcs.pre_conditions:
1. An FM/AM signal generator is ready
2. The HU Tuner source is selected on the Cabin Output Channel
3. The HU is in FM analog tuner mode
4. The tuned frequency is the lowest frequency of the current wave band
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Read and record the tuned frequency shown on the Radio Playing page
2. Press "Tune Down" on the Radio Playing page
3. Read the tuned frequency and listen to the audio output after the tune completes
tcs.expected_result:
1. The lowest frequency of the current wave band is displayed on the Radio Playing page
2. The tune request is accepted
3. The tuned frequency wraps around to the highest frequency in the current wave band, and that station is played
tcs.design_method: 邊界值分析 (Boundary Value Analysis, BVA)
